_comment: The locked design's seven seed tickets (Canopy Tickets.dc.html › seed()), translated
to our schema: statuses lowercase snake, person handles instead of the design's demo
logins, sprint ids 3 / 4 (the two in_progress sprints in roadmap.json) and null for the
backlog. The design's relative offsets are anchored at 2026-07-06T12:00:00Z, one day
after the seeded plan's updated_at, so the queue reads as 'this week'.
Handle mapping from the design's demo logins: jose-a → Jose-Gael-Cruz-Lopez,
dev-raj → AndresL230, the assignee 'meilin' → lpcooper-arch, the assignee 'sanaok'
→ Darkest-Teddy. meilin / sanaok stay themselves as REQUESTERS — they are the two
non-engineer staff seeded in scripts/seed/reset.mjs, and the whole point of the queue.
Ticket 2 is a sub-ticket of ticket 3 (the one parent/child pair); ticket 3 carries the
two links; tickets 1 and 6 are unassigned + open, so the sidebar badge reads 2.

tickets.title: CSV export from the gradebook fails over 1,000 rows
tickets.body: Exporting a full-school gradebook downloads an empty file. Under ~1,000 rows it works. Ops needs this for the end-of-term reports on Friday.

tickets.title: Access to the staging environment for the QA pass
tickets.body: The curriculum QA pass runs next week and needs a staging login that mirrors the production roles.

tickets.title: Add a “lesson duration” field to the curriculum planner
tickets.body: Teachers keep planning lessons that run long. A duration field per lesson, summed per unit, would let them see total time before the term starts.

comments.author: meilin
comments.body: Even a plain minutes field would help — no need for anything fancy.

comments.author: AndresL230
comments.body: Started on this. @meilin the planner needs a schema migration first — expect it on staging Thursday.

tickets.title: Why did Monday's enrollment digest arrive twice?
tickets.body: Both copies were identical, sent four minutes apart. Just checking nothing is double-counting enrollments.

comments.author: Darkest-Teddy
comments.body: A retry fired after a slow send was already through. Data was fine; the dedupe window is fixed as of yesterday.

tickets.title: Bulk-archive last term's classrooms
tickets.body: Could we get a one-click archive for all classrooms from the previous term?

comments.author: meilin
comments.body: The term rollover job already archives these automatically on Sep 30 — declining as covered.

tickets.title: Report builder times out on the attendance view
tickets.body: Any attendance report over one term spins for ~60s and then errors. Smaller ranges are fine. Started sometime last week.

tickets.title: SSO login loops for one staff account
tickets.body: One staff account bounces between the login page and the app without ever landing. Clearing cookies doesn't help.

comments.author: Jose-Gael-Cruz-Lopez
comments.body: Reproduced — the session cookie is being set with the wrong domain for this account's tenant. Fix in progress.
